hypothesis: Add the video's `tag` (content category id) from `video_features_basic_pure.csv` as a new FM categorical field. Per EDA's "unused data available" note, this is genuine content-level metadata not yet joined; unlike the earlier rejected `user_id`-keyed additions (profile fields, historical rate — both user-only and thus identical for the positive/negative pair within a single user in BPR training, contributing nothing to the pairwise score difference), `tag` varies *between* the positive and negative video in every BPR pair, so it can directly inform which of the two the model should rank higher — a mechanism the earlier feature attempts (tested only under the old pointwise-BCE objective anyway) never had.
expected_effect: GAUC should move more than nDCG@5, since a broad content-similarity signal helps distinguish relevance across a user's whole candidate set (what GAUC aggregates over all pairs), whereas nDCG@5 only scores the top-5 slice.
